question: In 2023 American rents on new leases had stopped rising, yet official rent inflation stayed high. Why?
options: The official index covers all sitting tenants
Rent controls were lifted in big cities
Owners' housing costs were counted twice
answer: The official index covers all sitting tenants. Most leases run a year, so the average rent paid moves only as leases come up for renewal. Adams and colleagues, government and Federal Reserve economists, found new-tenant rent inflation leads the official measure by about four quarters. The official figure was reporting last year's market.
move: Ask when the people in a statistic last had a chance to change.
ask: Which statistic I trust is lagging behind because its people rarely change?
trap: Suspecting a flaw in the arithmetic rather than in the timing.
